title: What will Donald Trump say during midterm rally in Daytona Beach, Florida originally scheduled for October 30, 2026? Fraud (3+ times)
rules:
If 
 Donald Trump says Fraud (3+ times) as part of midterm rally in Daytona Beach, Florida originally scheduled for October 30, 2026
, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the midterm rally in Daytona Beach, Florida originally scheduled for October 30, 2026 using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the midterm rally in Daytona Beach, Florida originally scheduled for October 30, 2026 will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Donald Trump speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Presence alone during a livestream is not sufficient for the market to qualify (e.g., inaudible private conversations on camera, unofficial statements picked up on a hot mic).
Except as otherwise specified, previously aired content, archival footage, and recordings captured at times, places, or events wholly separate from the featured address.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.

blind.reasoning: Trump's late-October 2026 rally speeches lean heavily on election fraud. At Corpus Christi on Oct 27 he said 'voter fraud' four times in one passage, and the new Alaska 'Decoy Dan'/Peltola story has him repeatedly calling it 'voter fraud at the highest level,' including at the South Carolina rally on Oct 29. With the Daytona rally confirmed for Oct 30, four days before Election Day, three or more uses of 'fraud' is likely but not certain.
blind.falsifier: A full transcript or video of the Oct 30 Daytona Beach rally shows Trump saying 'fraud' (or 'frauds'/'fraud's') two times or fewer, or the rally is cancelled.

final.reasoning: The market midpoint of 0.815 is nearly the same as my independent estimate of 0.82, so there is no meaningful edge on either side. The price supports my read that recent rallies and the Alaska story make 3+ uses of 'fraud' likely but not certain.
